name: accounts
description:
This attribute consolidates every account the Client mentions - bank, investment, government schemes, brokers and custody - into a single list so balances can be totalled per location. Return one item per distinct holding/instance mentioned. If the Client mentions a type only in aggregate, return one item for that type. Return an empty list when the group is not discussed. Return the list directly - there is no outer value/confidence wrapper.

Properties:
- account_type (enum, required): Type of account, e.g. 'bank_account', 'ppf'. Allowed values: investment_account, bank_account, ppf, bank_deposit, nps, ssy, epf, pms, aif, crypto_broker, self_custody, others. Meanings: ppf = Public Provident Fund; bank_deposit = fixed/recurring deposit held at a bank; nps = National Pension System; ssy = Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana; epf = Employees' Provident Fund; pms = Portfolio Management Service; aif = Alternative Investment Fund; crypto_broker = exchange or broker account for crypto; self_custody = crypto held in the Client's own wallet; others = any type not listed.
- provider (string, nullable): Bank / broker / fund house / wallet name, e.g. 'HDFC Bank', 'Zerodha'.
- account_name (string, nullable): Specific account or product name if given, e.g. 'Salary account'.
- location (enum, nullable): Where the account is held, e.g. 'India'. Allowed values: India, Foreign.
- balance (string, nullable): Account balance, e.g. 'INR 250000'. Currency code or unit, one space, digits only - no commas, no symbols, no words: 'INR 1000000', 'USD 5400', '50 units', '0.5 BTC'. Convert lakh/crore to digits (10 lakh -> INR 1000000). '0' when the Client says they have none of this type. 'Yes' when the Client has it but gave no figure. null when not mentioned.
- confidence (number, required): How confident the model is in this item (0-1).
- confidence_type (enum, required): quoted = stated verbatim; normalized = stated but reformatted (e.g. '10 lakh' -> 'INR 1000000'); inferred = clearly implied; calculated = derived from several stated pieces; not_found = no value found for this type. Allowed values: quoted, normalized, inferred, calculated, not_found.
- evidence (string, nullable): Short verbatim quote(s) from the transcript supporting this item.

Examples:
Example 1 - Client: "I have around 2.5 lakh in my HDFC salary account and about 8 lakh in PPF." -> [
  {
    "account_type": "bank_account",
    "provider": "HDFC Bank",
    "account_name": "Salary account",
    "location": "India",
    "balance": "INR 250000",
    "confidence": 0.9,
    "confidence_type": "normalized",
    "evidence": "around 2.5 lakh in my HDFC salary account"
  },
  {
    "account_type": "ppf",
    "provider": null,
    "account_name": null,
    "location": "India",
    "balance": "INR 800000",
    "confidence": 0.9,
    "confidence_type": "normalized",
    "evidence": "about 8 lakh in PPF"
  }
]
Example 2 - Client: "I keep about ten thousand dollars in my Chase savings account in the US." -> [
  {
    "account_type": "bank_account",
    "provider": "Chase",
    "account_name": "Savings account",
    "location": "Foreign",
    "balance": "USD 10000",
    "confidence": 0.9,
    "confidence_type": "normalized",
    "evidence": "about ten thousand dollars in my Chase savings account in the US"
  }
]
Example 3 - Client: "I do have an NPS account but I don't remember the balance, and I have no crypto account." -> [
  {
    "account_type": "nps",
    "provider": null,
    "account_name": null,
    "location": "India",
    "balance": "Yes",
    "confidence": 0.8,
    "confidence_type": "quoted",
    "evidence": "I do have an NPS account but I don't remember the balance"
  },
  {
    "account_type": "crypto_broker",
    "provider": null,
    "account_name": null,
    "location": null,
    "balance": "0",
    "confidence": 0.95,
    "confidence_type": "quoted",
    "evidence": "I have no crypto account"
  }
]

name: expenses
description:
This attribute consolidates every expense the Client mentions, recurring or one-time, into a single list so the planner sees the full outflow picture. Return one item per distinct holding/instance mentioned. If the Client mentions a type only in aggregate, return one item for that type. Return an empty list when the group is not discussed. Return the list directly - there is no outer value/confidence wrapper.

Properties:
- expense_type (enum, required): Type of expense, e.g. 'rent', 'travel_vacations'. Allowed values: rent, utilities, groceries, household_staff, childcare_school_fees, entertainment_dining, transport_fuel, family_support, shopping_purchases, subscriptions_memberships, insurance_premiums, travel_vacations, medical_expenses, loan_emis_education, loan_emis_personal, loan_emis_home, loan_emis_vehicle, loan_emis_others, loan_emis_total, charity_donations, miscellaneous, total. Meanings: loan_emis_* = EMI paid for that loan type; loan_emis_total = an explicitly stated total across EMIs; charity_donations = giving; miscellaneous = anything not listed; total = an explicitly stated total for the group.
- description (string, nullable): What the expense is for, e.g. '2BHK in Whitefield, Bengaluru'.
- amount (string, nullable): Amount per period, e.g. 'INR 30000'. Currency code or unit, one space, digits only - no commas, no symbols, no words: 'INR 1000000', 'USD 5400', '50 units', '0.5 BTC'. Convert lakh/crore to digits (10 lakh -> INR 1000000). '0' when the Client says they have none of this type. 'Yes' when the Client has it but gave no figure. null when not mentioned.
- frequency (enum, nullable): How often it recurs, e.g. 'monthly'. Keep the Client's own period - do NOT convert annual to monthly. Allowed values: monthly, annual, one_time.
- confidence (number, required): How confident the model is in this item (0-1).
- confidence_type (enum, required): quoted = stated verbatim; normalized = stated but reformatted (e.g. '10 lakh' -> 'INR 1000000'); inferred = clearly implied; calculated = derived from several stated pieces; not_found = no value found for this type. Allowed values: quoted, normalized, inferred, calculated, not_found.
- evidence (string, nullable): Short verbatim quote(s) from the transcript supporting this item.

Examples:
Example 1 - Client: "We pay 30k rent for our 2BHK in Whitefield and 5k for utilities every month." -> [
  {
    "expense_type": "rent",
    "description": "2BHK in Whitefield, Bengaluru",
    "amount": "INR 30000",
    "frequency": "monthly",
    "confidence": 0.9,
    "confidence_type": "normalized",
    "evidence": "We pay 30k rent for our 2BHK in Whitefield"
  },
  {
    "expense_type": "utilities",
    "description": null,
    "amount": "INR 5000",
    "frequency": "monthly",
    "confidence": 0.9,
    "confidence_type": "normalized",
    "evidence": "5k for utilities every month"
  }
]
Example 2 - Client: "We spend about 2 lakh a year on travel and vacations." -> [
  {
    "expense_type": "travel_vacations",
    "description": null,
    "amount": "INR 200000",
    "frequency": "annual",
    "confidence": 0.9,
    "confidence_type": "normalized",
    "evidence": "about 2 lakh a year on travel and vacations"
  }
]
Example 3 - Client: "Groceries I don't track exactly, and we pay zero rent since we own the house." -> [
  {
    "expense_type": "groceries",
    "description": null,
    "amount": "Yes",
    "frequency": null,
    "confidence": 0.8,
    "confidence_type": "quoted",
    "evidence": "Groceries I don't track exactly"
  },
  {
    "expense_type": "rent",
    "description": "Own house, no rent",

name: goals
description:
This attribute consolidates every goal the Client mentions into a single list so the planner can size, time and prioritise each one. Return one item per distinct holding/instance mentioned. If the Client mentions a type only in aggregate, return one item for that type. Return an empty list when the group is not discussed. Return the list directly - there is no outer value/confidence wrapper.

Properties:
- goal_type (enum, required): Type of goal, e.g. 'buying_a_house_india', 'financial_freedom_fire'. Allowed values: planning_a_child, child_s_college_education, child_s_higher_education, buying_a_house_india, buying_a_vehicle, wedding_expenses, parents_healthcare_fund, vacation_travel_fund, legacy_inheritance, financial_freedom_fire, other_goals. Meanings: planning_a_child = expecting- or first-child costs; child_s_college_education / child_s_higher_education = UG / PG or study-abroad costs; buying_a_house_india = India home purchase; financial_freedom_fire = retire-early corpus; legacy_inheritance = leave-behind for heirs; other_goals = any goal not listed.
- description (string, nullable): Goal in the Client's own terms, e.g. "Daughter's MS in the US".
- target_amount (string, nullable): Target corpus / cost, e.g. 'INR 8000000'. Currency code or unit, one space, digits only - no commas, no symbols, no words: 'INR 1000000', 'USD 5400', '50 units', '0.5 BTC'. Convert lakh/crore to digits (10 lakh -> INR 1000000). '0' when the Client says they have none of this type. 'Yes' when the Client has it but gave no figure. null when not mentioned.
- target_year (integer, nullable): Calendar year the Client wants to achieve the goal, e.g. 2032. If stated as 'in N years', add N to the meeting year and use confidence_type calculated.
- priority (enum, nullable): How important the goal is, e.g. 'high'. Only when the Client indicates it. Allowed values: high, medium, low.
- confidence (number, required): How confident the model is in this item (0-1).
- confidence_type (enum, required): quoted = stated verbatim; normalized = stated but reformatted (e.g. '10 lakh' -> 'INR 1000000'); inferred = clearly implied; calculated = derived from several stated pieces; not_found = no value found for this type. Allowed values: quoted, normalized, inferred, calculated, not_found.
- evidence (string, nullable): Short verbatim quote(s) from the transcript supporting this item.

Examples:
Example 1 - Client: "We want around 80 lakh for our daughter's MS in the US by 2032, and about 1 crore for a house in India." -> [
  {
    "goal_type": "child_s_higher_education",
    "description": "Daughter's MS in the US",
    "target_amount": "INR 8000000",
    "target_year": 2032,
    "priority": null,
    "confidence": 0.85,
    "confidence_type": "normalized",
    "evidence": "around 80 lakh for our daughter's MS in the US by 2032"
  },
  {
    "goal_type": "buying_a_house_india",
    "description": "House in India",
    "target_amount": "INR 10000000",
    "target_year": null,
    "priority": null,
    "confidence": 0.85,
    "confidence_type": "normalized",
    "evidence": "about 1 crore for a house in India"
  }
]
Example 2 - Client: "We want to retire in 15 years with a 5 crore corpus. (Meeting year 2026.)" -> [
  {
    "goal_type": "financial_freedom_fire",
    "description": "Retire with a 5 crore corpus",
    "target_amount": "INR 50000000",
    "target_year": 2041,
    "priority": null,
    "confidence": 0.8,
    "confidence_type": "calculated",
    "evidence": "retire in 15 years with a 5 crore corpus"
  }
]
Example 3 - Client: "We are planning for a child but haven't fixed any amount yet." -> [
  {
    "goal_type": "planning_a_child",
    "description": "Planning for a child",
    "target_amount": "Yes",

    "priority": null,
    "confidence": 0.85,
    "confidence_type": "quoted",
    "evidence": "planning for a child but haven't fixed any amount yet"
  }
]

name: insurance_policies

The two boolean adequacy judgements (term_insurance_coverage_adequacy, health_insurance_coverage_adequacy) stay as separate attributes. Return one item per distinct holding/instance mentioned. If the Client mentions a type only in aggregate, return one item for that type. Return an empty list when the group is not discussed. Return the list directly - there is no outer value/confidence wrapper.

Properties:
- insurance_type (enum, required): Type of policy, e.g. 'life_term', 'health'. Allowed values: life_term, health, ulip, other. Meanings: life_term = pure protection term cover; health = medical cover; ulip = Unit Linked Insurance Plan (investment-cum-insurance); other = any policy not listed.
- insurer (string, nullable): Insurance company, e.g. 'HDFC Life', 'Star Health'.
- policy_name (string, nullable): Plan name if given, e.g. 'Click 2 Protect'.
- covered_members (string, nullable): Who is covered, e.g. 'self', 'self, spouse, 2 children'.
